profile.intro: I am a full-stack developer with years in the market. I build solutions for your business: web applications, management platforms, integrations, and storefronts, with or without a payment gateway.
profile.body1: I look at your business, prepare a proposal, and hand you a complete package, ready to put to work.
profile.body2: I work with Linux and apply AI automation to workflows.
profile.agencyBefore: Many of my projects were under the wing of the ecommerce and B2B agency
profile.agencyAfter: The main ones I worked on are listed here.

tonica.body: I have worked at Tónica since 2022, where I work as a full-stack programmer. My work includes scalable, configurable Shopify themes and apps that extend the platform’s native features: geolocation systems for assigning the right branch, quoting and budgeting tools, and differentiated price lists. I also build custom software for each client’s needs, including bespoke e-commerce platforms, quoting systems for insurers such as Sancor and SMG, and ongoing database and systems maintenance.

freelance.body: As a freelance developer I build landing pages, custom business-management systems — including cash handling —, appointment and multi-schedule software for clinics, and custom designs.

education.body: Electrical and electronics engineering at Universidad Nacional de La Plata, from 2018 to 2020.

pekata.title: Pekata Foods
pekata.summary: A portal where each employee chooses a holiday hamper while HR keeps control of budget, users, and deliveries.
pekata.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Pekata Foods store: the headline says the ideal hamper is one click away, beside a gift box of wine, ham, and cheese.
pekata.challenge: Pekata sold corporate hampers through employee spreadsheets, email, and a logistics process that was hard to scale. They wanted each employee to choose a gift inside a budget set by the company, without HR losing control.
pekata.solution: A storefront for the employee and a management portal for HR. Each client company loads its staff list, assigns a budget per person, and the employee chooses and configures delivery. Pekata sees the logistics operation in one view.
pekata.result: Tónica's case study publishes three campaign results: 3× the volume processed, 70% fewer hours of manual HR work, and 92% employee satisfaction, measured as an internal NPS.

crucijuegos.title: Crucijuegos
crucijuegos.summary: A technical portal with a deep catalog, visible certifications, and an online quoter for municipalities, companies, and institutions.
crucijuegos.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Crucijuegos portal, a manufacturer of playground equipment and street furniture.
crucijuegos.challenge: Crucijuegos manufactures playground equipment, street furniture, water parks, and inclusive play, and sells to municipalities, companies, and institutions. Catalogs lived in PDFs, and enquiries came in by email or phone.
crucijuegos.solution: A portal with a technical catalog by category, downloadable spec sheets, certifications in view, and a quoter that builds the item list and sends it to the sales team. The site is published in Spanish, English, Italian, and Portuguese.
crucijuegos.result: Tónica's case study publishes one numbered result: 4 languages in production (ES, EN, IT, PT).

printemps.title: Grupo Printemps
printemps.summary: A Shopify store that organizes 7 catalog divisions in one experience, with a fast reorder flow and the official Sauleda representation.
printemps.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Grupo Printemps store, with the years-in-business counter and the catalog divisions.
printemps.challenge: Grupo Printemps has operated since 1992 with a catalog of curtains, awnings, agriculture, pets, pools, hardware, and leisure. A flat catalog could not organize 7 divisions or serve frequent customers who reorder.
printemps.solution: A Shopify store with a custom theme that brings the 7 divisions together, a Comprá Rápido flow for reordering known products, search by product code, and the official Sauleda representation mark.
printemps.result: Tónica's case study publishes one numbered result: 7 catalog divisions in a single Shopify store.

fiume.title: Fiume Shop
fiume.summary: An online store that brings together contemporary fashion, sport, and official Argentine club kits, with seasonal drops and promos such as Cyber Fiume.
fiume.imageAlt: Screenshot of Fiume Shop with a Godoy Cruz jersey and a row of club crests.
fiume.challenge: Fiume sells contemporary fashion, sport, and official Argentine club kits to the same audience. Each line needs its own language, seasonal drops, and the installment payments the local market expects.
fiume.solution: Shopify with a custom theme and a line-based architecture (Fashion, Sport, and Clubs), local financing, free shipping above a threshold, and a featured-clubs module on the home page.
fiume.result: Tónica's case study publishes one numbered result: 3 catalog lines brought together (Fashion, Sport, and Clubs).

herLighting.title: Her Lighting
herLighting.summary: A technical catalog of architectural lighting, with a project gallery and a quote cart instead of checkout.
herLighting.imageAlt: Screenshot of Her Lighting, an architectural lighting catalog with the headline Passion for light.
herLighting.challenge: In architectural lighting the specifier does not buy online: they build a list of luminaires and ask for a quote. Her Lighting needed a technical catalog for architects and a quote request without friction.
herLighting.solution: Technical product pages with spec downloads, a project gallery, and a cart that does not start checkout: it builds the quote request and sends it to the sales team. The site is published in Spanish and English.
herLighting.result: Tónica's case study publishes one numbered result: 2 languages in production (ES, EN).

robinLamps.title: Robin Lamps
robinLamps.summary: A Shopify store for decorative lighting in Barcelona, with a public catalog and a professional B2B shop in Spanish, English, and French.
robinLamps.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Robin Lamps store on the Bowie product page.
robinLamps.challenge: Robin Lamps, in Barcelona, needed to sell to the public and to professionals — architects, interior designers, and distributors — with different prices, several languages, and a technical download per product. Orders used to arrive mixed between email and PDF catalogs.
robinLamps.solution: Shopify with an editorial theme, Shopify Markets in Spanish, English, and French, a professional store with wholesale prices, and account signup with manual approval.
robinLamps.result: Tónica's case study publishes one numbered result: 3 languages in production (ES, EN, FR).
